 assert len(s[k])==n and all(x['status']=='unmeasured' and x['denominator']==0 for x in s[k])

h=json.loads(Path('/home/ianblenke/github.com/ianblenke/carnot/results/experiment_8990_v768_graph_corpus_a.json').read_bytes()); rows=h['invocation_ledger']
assert len({x['call_id'] for x in rows})==len(rows)
assert sum(x['operation']=='generation' and x['status']=='completed' for x in rows)==s['historical_generation_calls_counted_once']==512

assert all(x==0 for x in v['model_invocation_counts'].values())
assert v['independent_generalization_score']==0 and not s['scientific_benefit']

print('independent reduction:14 slots,7 graph,10 causal,4 natural,1823 exposed groups,512 historical calls; PASS',flush=True)
